_nota: Authored, not translated (D-022). F9 · children's groups (#381-#383, #387). No free text anywhere near a child (red line #3): every string here is shown to ADULTS. Numbers never appear hard-coded — they arrive as {placeholders} resolved by formatear(). The 'Not verified' badge is neutral by design (Bark pattern: the badge is positive-when-present, its absence is the signal — never a red alarm).
grupo.proximamente.cuerpo: Classrooms and parents' clubs are coming soon to your region.
grupo.casa.lead: Classrooms and parents' clubs: you approve who your child joins, and you see exactly what the group sees about them.
grupo.indice.lead: The classrooms and clubs you run. Each member's parent approved their entry after seeing who you are.
grupo.indice.vacio: You don't run any group yet.
grupo.estado.codigoApagado: The join code is off. Approved members are not affected.
grupo.nuevo.lead: You will get a six-character code. Share it only with your students' parents: each one will see your name and your badge before approving.
grupo.nuevo.origen: What kind of group is it?
grupo.nuevo.tamanoPista: Up to {max} children for this kind of group.
grupo.nuevo.sinEscuela: No verified school — parents will see the 'Not verified' badge.
grupo.identidad.lead: Before you open a group, write who you are. Parents will read exactly this, next to a badge that says nobody checked it.
grupo.identidad.pista: For example: “4th grade teacher at Escuela Benito Juárez” or “mom of two, organizing a club for the neighborhood”. You wrote this yourself — nobody verified it, and that is what the badge will say.
grupo.grupo.codigoPista: Share it only with your students' parents. Each parent sees your identity before approving.
grupo.grupo.desactivado: The code is off. Parents who have it cannot use it; approved members are not affected.
grupo.grupo.creado: Your group is ready. This is its code:
grupo.grupo.vacio: No approved members yet. When a parent approves their child's entry, the child appears here.
grupo.grupo.tablaVacia: Nobody is on the leaderboard yet. It is off by default: each parent turns it on when approving, or later.
grupo.unirse.lead: Enter the six-character code you received. Before anything is decided, you will see who runs the group.
grupo.unirse.codigoInactivo: This code is not active. Check it with the person who gave it to you.
grupo.tarjeta.loQueDeclaro: What this person says about themselves:
grupo.tarjeta.nadieLoComprobo: They wrote this themselves and nobody checked it.
grupo.tarjeta.dominioExplica: Their email belongs to a known school domain. That proves they control that mailbox — not that they teach there.
grupo.tarjeta.revisadoExplica: Someone from our team looked at this declaration.
grupo.tarjeta.verificadaExplica: Their school is verified and still lists them as an active teacher.
grupo.tarjeta.queVera: What they will see about your child: their alias, their streak and their points. Nothing else.
grupo.tarjeta.toggle: May appear in the group's leaderboard (off by default)
grupo.tarjeta.sinHijos: All your children already have a request for this group.
grupo.hecho.aprobada: Approved. Your child is now part of the group.
grupo.hecho.rechazada: Declined. The group's owner is not told why — your child simply does not appear.
grupo.hecho.pendiente: Saved for later. The request stays in your account until you decide.
grupo.escuela.lead: A verified school vouches for its teachers. Verification is done once, by a person, and works the same in every country.
grupo.escuela.documentoPista: Any document with the school's letterhead, name and address — a person reviews it by eye. AVIF or PDF.
grupo.escuela.dominioPista: If your email belongs to a school domain we already recognize, verification is automatic and you don't need the document.
grupo.escuela.hechoDominio: Your email domain is recognized: the school is verified and you are listed as its teacher.
grupo.escuela.hechoDocumento: Received. A person reviews each document; we'll email you when it's done.
grupo.err.generico: Something didn't work. Please try again.
grupo.err.tope: You've reached the maximum number of groups per account.
grupo.err.unoPorDia: You already created a group today. You can create another tomorrow.
grupo.err.tamano: That size is not allowed for this kind of group.
grupo.err.escuelaNoVerificada: That school is not verified, or no longer lists you as an active teacher.
grupo.err.solicitudViva: This child already has a request for this group.
grupo.err.documento: We need the document to review the school.
grupo.err.tipoDocumento: The document must be AVIF or PDF.
grupo.err.codigo: That doesn't look like a group code: six letters and numbers.
